code:
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv("survey.csv")
sub = df.head(30)
r = stats.spearmanr(sub["income"], sub["sleep_hours"])
print(f"n = {len(sub)}")
print(f"rho = {r.statistic:.2f}, p = {r.pvalue:.2f}")
analysis: No association between income and sleep_hours (rho = 0.05, p = 0.79, n = 30).
